title_en: Beast of Reincarnation on PS5 Drops to a New Low Price at Amazon in Early Prime Day Deals
summary_en: Amazon has knocked Beast of Reincarnation on PS5 down to a new low price of $51.30, saving you just over $8 off its usual list price.
body_en:
Between Nintendo's Customer Appreciation Sale and Amazon's upcoming Prime Big Deal Days event , it's a perfect time to shop around and save on some physical games. The latter even has some great deals live right now that are well worth looking at. One that's caught our eye is on Game Freak's latest release, Beast of Reincarnation , which has just hit a new low price at the retailer on PS5 ( see it here ).
Usually this copy is priced at $59.99, but those interested in jumping into this new action RPG can pick it up for $51.30 right now from Amazon. That saves you just over $8. It's not a huge discount, but it's a welcome one considering the game only just released early last month.
While its initial response at launch was quite mixed, developer Game Freak has since announced a plan to patch it with "a series of continuous updates." Some of these included camera adjustments, increased text size, story pacing improvements, bug fixes, and more to help give the game a bit of a lift. And while IGN's own review gave it a 6/10, writer Travis Northup did note that it has "some great ideas blossoming" even if they're "hard to spot among the weeds."
Mainly, Northup wrote that the game has "an interesting, apocalyptic setting, an extremely memorable wolf companion, and an action-packed beast-battling premise that is instantly very cool," but unfortunately, "its execution falls short of its promising ideas more often than not." If you're curious to see what the latest patch update has adjusted, you can check out publisher Fictions latest patch notes page here .
Regardless, if you've been eager to boot up Beast of Reincarnation on your PS5, this is a great time to grab it and save a little cash as a bonus. And if you're on the hunt for even more game deals, make sure to check out Nintendo's Customer Appreciation Sale for some big discounts on Switch games while it's still live.
It's also worth marking your calendar for October 6, so you don't miss out on Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days sale. This only runs for two days, through October 7, so you'll have a short 48-hour period to snag the games on sale that catch your eye.
Hannah Hoolihan is a freelancer who writes with the commerce team here at IGN.
